description: Event Log app (Журнал событий) and Personal Files app (Личные дела) for the terminal
steps: Create a new shared event log store. Add state in EditorApp.tsx: useState<Array<{time: string, action: string, actor: string}>> for the event log. Create a helper function addEventLog(action: string, actor: string) that pushes a new entry with current time formatted as HH:MM.

Hook the event log into existing actions: when cells are opened/closed, log it (e.g. '12:05 - Клетки открыты (Охранник)'); when garage doors are locked/unlocked, log it; when a rental door is rented, log it (e.g. '12:10 - Игрок арендовал Камеру 1'). Add calls to addEventLog at each relevant action point in EditorApp.tsx.

Add 'Журнал событий' (Event Log) terminal app: add 'eventlog' to the terminalApp state union type. Create a Win95-style window (following the same pattern as the info/map/settings windows) that shows a scrollable list of all event log entries. Each entry displays 'HH:MM - Action (Actor)'. Add a desktop icon and start menu entry for it.
Add Personal Files app state: useState for documents array [{id: string, name: string, description: string, createdAt: string}]. Add 'personalfiles' to the terminalApp state union type.

Create 'Личные дела' (Personal Files) terminal app window with two views: (a) document list view showing all created documents with delete buttons, (b) create new document form with 'Имя' (name) and 'Описание' (description) text inputs and a 'Создать' button. Use Win95 window styling consistent with existing apps.
Wire Personal Files create/delete to event log: when a document is created, log 'Создан документ: [name] (Охранник)'; when deleted, log 'Удалён документ: [name] (Охранник)'.
Add desktop icons for both new apps (event log icon and personal files icon) on the desktop, and add entries in the Start Menu.
acceptance_criteria: Event Log app opens from desktop icon or start menu, shows scrollable list of timestamped actions
Actions like opening/closing cells, locking doors, renting cells are logged with actor name
Personal Files app allows creating a document with Name and Description fields
Created documents appear in a browsable list within the Personal Files app
Documents can be deleted from the list
Creating and deleting documents generates entries in the Event Log
npm run build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/JailBreak-v0-9/JailBreak-1.2 && npm run build' and confirm it succeeds
findings: Implementation complete. Added eventLog state with addEventLog helper (useCallback with empty deps). Added personalFiles state with list/create views. Hooked addEventLog into: cells open/close buttons, handleLockGarageDoors, handleUnlockGarageDoors, handleTempLockGarageDoors, and both rental door success paths (keyboard and click). Added 'eventlog' and 'personalfiles' to terminalApp union type and handleStartMenuApp type. Added Win95-style windows for both apps. Added desktop icons and start menu entries. Build passes cleanly.
